shared_elements: relief carving of figures facing one direction
multiple figures arranged in a row/register
headgear or helmet on human figures
justification: Both depict human figures in profile arranged in a row in relief, with headgear and a raised arm, which is a generic correspondence any figural tradition might produce. A shows crude, schematic small full-body warriors above a large quadruped in a framed arched panel with a zigzag border, while B shows only large, closely detailed bearded heads and hands with patterned beards and tall caps, with no animal, frame or border.
